Backend: 16/16 tests PASS (test_iteration72_reels_lives.py, junit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration72.xml). Frontend: /feed loads with glass (backdrop-filter=blur(28px) saturate(1.8)), 7 PostCards; /reels renders both reels with all right-rail testids (like/comments/save/share/minimize/follow/author/retry) and the 3 tabs (Siguiendo/Para ti/En vivo) + history + create buttons; like/comment/share/save/history sheets all wire up (Save toggles Guardar→Guardado, comment posts OK, share-sheet with copy present, history sheet opens). Video decode does show 'Reintentar' as expected (H.264 not decoded in headless — env limitation, NOT a bug). /map auto-switches after ~9s to OSM: data-testid map-osm-fallback present, map-engine-label='Mapa libre + PIUP', 12 leaflet tiles loaded. /lives/start setup card renders title input, 10 category chips, public/private toggles and live-go-btn; toggling private reveals live-anticapture-toggle. /lives shows En vivo grid + private code input + 'No hay transmisiones' empty state. Desktop 1920x800 /feed: no horizontal overflow, glass preserved, mobile nav correctly hidden. MobileBottomNav pill + publish-menu-sheet open OK from nav-create.

minor.issue: For private lives with wrong code, the server calls websocket.close(code=4003) BEFORE websocket.accept(). Because the WS upgrade never happens, the ingress/Cloudflare returns HTTP 403 during handshake instead of a proper WS Close frame with 4003. Functional: the connection is correctly rejected — but browser clients that inspect the close code will see an HTTP 403 rejection rather than a 4003 close frame. Consider await websocket.accept() first, then send an error json, then close(4003).

action_items: (Optional/minor) Adjust WS rejection for private-lives wrong-code to emit a proper 4003 close frame instead of HTTP 403 (accept → send error → close(4003)).
critical_code_review_comments: lives.py:409 — websocket.close(code=4003) is called before accept(); Starlette translates that to HTTP 403 during the handshake, so clients cannot read the 4003 code. Not blocking but confuses clients that key off close codes.
posts_feed.py:325 — reels pool is limited to 600 recent posts before scoring; on large catalogs this may starve the small-creator boost. Consider a two-pass query (recent + long-tail sampling).
posts_feed.py:315 — affinity_authors is derived from the last 100 likes without a time window; very old likes can dominate 'for_you'. Consider a 30–60 day filter.
